We construct XX- (Hubbard-) like models based on the unitary superalgebra gl(N |M).

(i) we have constructed XX and Hubbard models based on the superalgebra gl(N |M), (ii) we have derived the corresponding R-matrix, (iii) we have derived their local Hamiltonians in the transfer matrix formulation, (iv) we have determined their symmetries, and (v) in the cases of gl(1|1) and gl(1|3) XX models we have performed a two loop perturbative calculation
the super-Hubbard models are integrable models with a Yang-Baxter R-matrix and a local Hamiltonian that can be derived from the transfer matrix formalisms.

the construction of new integrable quantum models, the study of their symmetries and the determination of their physical properties.
